title: Moment-Selective Quantum Designs in Aperiodic Temporal Ensembles
summary: We introduce a general mechanism for engineering moment-selective temporal designs with hierarchically structured aperiodic drives. At special control settings where the driven dynamics is constrained by a finite symmetry group, lower-order moments can already reproduce Haar statistics while a selected higher-order deviation remains nonzero. A small static detuning from such a setting generically produces an exponentially long lifetime whose exponent scales inversely with the square of the detuning.
